reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       SUM(CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS big_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS other_lines
FROM sales
GROUP BY parent_category
alternatives: SELECT parent_category, SUM(CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS big_lines, COUNT(*) - SUM(CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_lines FROM sales GROUP BY parent_category

SELECT parent_category, COUNT(CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 1 END) AS big_lines, COUNT(CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur < 100 OR net_revenue_eur IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS other_lines FROM sales GROUP BY 1
